login.title: EDEKA Account & PAYBACK Setup
login.description:
### 💳 EDEKA / PAYBACK Account

- **Barcode / Card Number**: Enter your PAYBACK or EDEKA card number to display a live QR code for scanning at checkout.
- **Account Session Token**: Enter your `KEYCLOAK_IDENTITY` cookie value (starts with `ey...`) from the login portal (F12 > Application > Cookies).

📖 For detailed instructions, see the EDEKA Integration Documentation on GitHub.
